sample_unit: AI-generated patient education guides (3 topics x 2 models)

links.outcome: Flesch reading ease of AI-generated patient education guides
links.effect: Reading ease was 36.30±7.01 for ChatGPT and 46.77±4.96 for Google Gemini; ChatGPT's ease score was significantly different from Gemini's, and both are in the difficult-to-read range.
links.quote: Ease of readability for ChatGPT responses was 36.30±7.01 and for Google Gemini 46.77±4.96.

unlisted_practices: Screening AI-generated patient education text for similarity/plagiarism with QuillBot

screen.reason: Evaluates readability, plagiarism similarity, and scientific reliability of patient education materials generated by ChatGPT vs Google Gemini without testing a deployment practice.
